IDENTITY OVERRIDE (highest priority, fixes a previous attempt that produced a DIFFERENT girl): the child must be EXACTLY the girl in face reference #3 and expression sheet #4 - Child KB: 10-12 years old, long STRAIGHT auburn (red-brown) hair with centre parting and NO bangs, freckles across the nose and cheeks, slim pre-teen build, natural friendly smile. Copy her face feature by feature (eye shape and spacing, nose, lips, jawline, eyebrows, skin); do not generate a generic child, do not change hair colour/length/style, do not age her. If in doubt, make the face look MORE like #3.

COMPRESSION / ROUNDNESS OVERRIDE (highest priority - see reference #7, a real photo of a child sitting on the same Yogibo Pyramid): the Pyramid is a SOFT bead-filled cushion. When someone sits or leans on it, it SQUASHES: its faces bulge OUTWARD in smooth convex rounded curves, the bottom edges spread and round off against the floor, the apex softens into a rounded point, and the whole silhouette reads as a plump, rounded triangular blob - NOT a crisp geometric pyramid with sharp straight edges and flat faces. Copy the soft rounded bulging look of #7 exactly (the same degree of roundness and squash), only the colour, the person and the scene differ. The seams are soft, no hard creases.

Photorealistic e-commerce lifestyle thumbnail, square 1:1, 2048px.

TASK: Place Child KB with the blossom pink Yogibo Pyramid floor cushion of shape reference #1, in the exact pose, cushion orientation and camera angle of #2, in a clean studio.

Silhouette and orientation exactly as #1/#2 (standing upright, apex up). STRICTLY NO chair shape, NO round bean bag, NO armrests, NO piping, NO zipper, NO visible brand tag, NO square cube.
EXACT SIZE: 66 cm tall (upright) x 75 x 75 cm base, 2.2 kg. ABSOLUTE SIZE RULE - VERY IMPORTANT: the Pyramid is a fixed-size object (66 cm tall upright, 75 x 75 cm base); it does NOT shrink for a child. For child KB (150 cm) sitting on the floor in front of it, the apex reaches about the top of her head / ears; the base is clearly wider than her shoulders.
COLOR: blossom pink #E5B9C8 - see colour swatch #6: the exact same soft dusty blossom pink (a muted light rose) over the whole cover, never shifting toward hot pink, coral, peach, lavender, red or white. FABRIC: soft matte stretch cotton-spandex cover.
